columns.comment: Calendar date of the freshness check. Today is 30-Sep-2026 (never use CURRENT_DATE); "last N days" means Date between DATE'2026-09-30' minus (N-1) days and DATE'2026-09-30'. Point-in-time measures ordered by Date return the last date of any longer period you group by.
columns.name: Date

columns.comment: Calendar month of the freshness check as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01'. Point-in-time measures grouped by Month return the month's last date (month-end); the latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the freshness check, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of a month (the month-end snapshot date of the freshness check).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Lakehouse publishing the share: JP (Tokyo head office), EMEA or AMER - "from Japan" means JP.
columns.name: Provider Region

columns.comment: Delta Share the table arrives in: jp_head_office_share, emea_regional_share or amer_regional_share.
columns.name: Share

columns.comment: Shared table, e.g. share_jp_parent_rating, share_jp_group_master, share_jp_support_letters, share_emea_exposure_monthly, share_amer_entity_master.
columns.name: Shared Table

columns.comment: Outcome of the provider's scheduled daily refresh: Success, Late or Failed.

columns.name: Is Stale

columns.comment: Average hours since the last provider refresh across the selected tables and days.
columns.name: Average Lag Hours

columns.comment: Largest lag in hours over the selected tables and days (124.6h for share_jp_parent_rating on 15-Aug-2026).
columns.name: Max Lag Hours

columns.comment: Table-days with lag above 24 hours (stale days) over the selection - a flow.
columns.name: Stale Table-Days

columns.name: Tables Stale

columns.comment: Shared tables with a freshness check in the selection.
columns.name: Tables Monitored

columns.name: Freshness SLA Met %

columns.name: Failed Refreshes

columns.comment: Days on which the provider changed a shared table's schema.
columns.name: Schema Drift Events

columns.comment: Longest run of consecutive stale days of a table within the selection (5 for share_jp_parent_rating in Aug-2026).
columns.name: Longest Stale Run Days

columns.comment: Rows in the shared tables at the check on the last day of the selection - point-in-time.
columns.name: Row Count

columns.comment: Shared tables stale on the last day of the selection (today = 30-Sep-2026) - point-in-time.
columns.name: Tables Stale Latest Day

comment: Delta Sharing freshness of the 11 tables shared by the JP (Tokyo head office), EMEA and AMER lakehouses, daily Apr-2024 to Sep-2026: average and maximum lag since the last provider refresh (hours, SLA 24h), stale table-days and stale tables (lag > 24h), share of days within SLA, failed refreshes, schema drift events, the longest stale run and the shared row count. Storyline 13: share_jp_parent_rating was not refreshed 11-15 Aug 2026 (5 stale days, lag up to 125h). Lag and stale counts cover the selected days; Row Count and Tables Stale Latest Day are point-in-time (last day of the selection). Grain: one row per shared table per day (gold.fact_delta_share_freshness_daily).
